GOVERNORS ARE THE TWO ALREADY OWNED and no more, pomagac and dziekowac; dziekuje (1sg) is owned back at trunk_social_a1 as the bare social chunk and b1_dative_sg's own shorthand line says 'dziekuje (juz twoje)' before conjugating the rest. THE a2_dat_chunks FRAME IS FENCED: podoba mi sie / smakuje mi take dative PRONOUNS, and a plural dative NOUN in that frame is a different construction shape, not a new ending - held and logged. DISTRACTORS ARE UNUSUALLY GOOD BECAUSE OF THE TWO PREVIOUS UNITS: for most of the cast the choice list is four real forms of the SAME noun in four different cases. Quiz item 9's answer is LAST lesson's ending (corkami after z), the guard b2_loc_pl used, and item 10 puts both endings on ONE noun in ONE sentence (Mieszkam z rodzicami i pomagam rodzicom). FENCED, all verified NEW: braciom/bratom; nauczycielom and lekarzom - those nouns appear as SUBJECTS only, and a draft use item wanting nauczycielom was rewritten rather than allowed to add a thirteenth form; czemu; mamom and tatom, deliberately, since mamy is AGENTS.md's own headline homograph (the VERB 'we have' at a1_miec); all dative plural pronouns beyond the owned mi/ci/mu/jej/nam/wam/im. No plural adjectives anywhere (spine O3 -> C1).

nodes.label: Szkół, książek, okien
nodes.label_en: Genitive plural · the words that change
nodes.note: B2 Block 5, unit 4 of 7 (spine O10). Opens what a2_gen_pl fenced, as CLOSED FAMILIES OF WHOLE FORMS, never a productive rule. Twelve new forms, four per family: szkol/gor/drog/slow (o -> accented o); ksiazek/kurtek/corek/okien (an e appears); hoteli/nauczycieli/kluczy/lekarzy (soft masculines refusing -ow). THE LEFT COLUMN IS THE DICTIONARY SINGULAR, NOT THE NOMINATIVE PLURAL - a deliberate departure from the spine brief, because szkoly, ksiazki and kurtki are all owned as GENITIVE SINGULARS and as plurals nowhere, so the brief taken literally would have killed szkol and ksiazek, the two forms the spine names first. a2_gen_pl built from the dictionary form too. drogi is fenced from the pack entirely: it is TAUGHT by leaf_shopping_a1 as the ADJECTIVE 'expensive', and it was the obvious lead distractor for drog. No fabricated string is printed anywhere, though the natural distractor for every item is the regular ending the word refuses; a2_gen_pl did print such strings and this pack does not follow it there. Quiz 10's answer is gazet, deliberately not this lesson's family. Every numeral phrase is an OBJECT - b2_num_subject is the next node and owns neuter-singular agreement. Fenced: wiele, slowa, oknie, virile numerals, all plural adjectives (O3 -> C1), so the pack is bare-noun throughout like the three before it.

nodes.label: Pięć osób było
nodes.label_en: Counted subjects · what the verb does
nodes.note: B2 Block 5, unit 5 of 7 (spine O8). ONE FACT: a counted phrase as the SUBJECT of a verb takes a NEUTER SINGULAR verb from five upwards (Piec osob bylo) and an ordinary plural at 2-4 (Dwie osoby byly). This is a2_numbers_gen's own deferral in its own words, never built. Only TWO new lemmas, osoby and osob - the content is a structure, so every verb form drilled is owned from A2 and every counted noun is recycled. osob is a vowel-shift genitive plural, the family taught one node earlier, and slide 2 says so. Board is six minimal pairs in the past, where the contrast is loudest; present and future carry the same rule on slide 2 and in four quiz items. ADJECTIVES ARE FENCED ABSOLUTELY and that is load-bearing: piec okien bylo nowych needs a GENITIVE PLURAL adjective, which spine O3 hands to C1. duzo is the same fact, not a second one. Word order is subject-first throughout; inversion is a second fact and was held. Fenced: wiele/wielu, all virile numerals (next node), and piwa as a plural (owned as the genitive singular in duzo piwa).

nodes.label: Pięciu studentów
nodes.label_en: Counting men · the numbers change shape
nodes.note: B2 Block 5, unit 6 of 7 (spine O8). Pays a2_numbers_gen's second and last deferral - 'NO PEOPLE-COUNTING anywhere, virile numerals (pieciu) are B1' - never built until now. Ten new forms: six numerals (dwoch, trzech, czterech, pieciu, szesciu, dziesieciu) and four genitive plurals (studentow, kolegow, synow, klientow); lekarzy and nauczycieli come free from gen_pl_full two nodes back. FRAMED AS A GIFT, which is the whole design: counting men looks like three new facts and taught that way it is a cliff, but two of the three are just what num_subject taught one node earlier for 5+, so the honest line is that with these numbers there is NO 2-4 exception at all. Only the six numerals are new. dwaj is fenced - a second system that would undo that claim. THE FEMININE GUARD IS THE MOST IMPORTANT THING HERE: osoba means person but is FEMININE, so piec osob and never pieciu; quiz 9 and use item 8 are that guard. byli is the sharpest distractor in the block and appears twice. studentami is fenced (verified NEW - b2_inst_pl dropped it over the ze s-cluster problem). A first-draft title carried two untaught words and was caught by the token scanner, not by eye.

nodes.label: Siłownia · domy i ludzie
nodes.label_en: Plural gym · every job the plural does
nodes.note: B2 Block 5, unit 7 of 7 (spine O9) - the gym that closes the plural block. Gym idiom (a1_case_gym / a2_case_gym2 / b1_case_gym / b1_virile_gym / b2_adj_gym line): ZERO new material, teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both EMPTY. WHY IT EARNS ITS SLOT against AGENTS.md's post-a2_past_gym rule: seven plural jobs arrived one per node across six consecutive units and were NEVER once mixed - the endings are easy, choosing between them is the cliff, and nothing on the path has ever asked for that. If Dad finds it comfortable the verdict is James's and the bank becomes stations feed. THE SPINE BRIEF WAS RE-READ against what is actually taught, as B2-DIGEST batch 9 instructed: it predates gen_pl_full, num_subject and num_virile, so slide 3 adds the two numeral agreement patterns rather than leaving the block's newest units undrilled. SLIDE 2 RUNS OPPOSITE TO b2_adj_gym'S and that is the value the gym adds: -ach, -ami and -om each do exactly ONE job and never ask about gender, so all the difficulty in the plural is concentrated in the Genitive. KONTROLA ITEMS 6 AND 7 ARE DELIBERATELY THE SAME FOUR CHOICES in the same order (rodzicami / rodzicom / rodzice / rodzina) under two different sentences - the b2_adj_gym paired-item idiom. All 12 quiz answers distinct. NO ADJECTIVES ANYWHERE, a logged scope call: nowe/duze are owned in the Nom/Acc plural but plural oblique adjectives are C1 (O3), and a board that allows one in two jobs and forbids it in five teaches the wrong lesson by silence - bare nouns throughout, matching the six units before it. HOMOGRAPH CHECKS: szkoly, kawy, piwa, miasta, biura, ksiazki, herbaty, zupy, kurtki are owned as GENITIVE SINGULARS and appear in no plural job here; szkolach and szkol do appear, because those forms are unambiguous; klucze left out over b2_gen_pl_full's ambiguous-number finding; drogi appears nowhere (leaf_shopping_a1 owns that string as the adjective 'expensive'). FENCED: siostry, koledzy, bracia, mezczyzni, ryby, wiele, kilka, dwaj, piecioro, widze, pracowalo - all verified NEW; inverted word order with a counted subject (held to C1 by b2_num_subject); no oblique pronouns, a fence audit.py cannot see because person pronouns sit in GLUE_LEMMAS.

nodes.label: Nie piję kawy · dopełniacz
nodes.label_en: The genitive after nie — not just after nie mam
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 1. The genitive of negation, generalised off miec. a1_negation taught nie mam kawy at A1 as a fact about ONE verb; it is a fact about every negated transitive verb, and this unit says so. ONE NEW LEMMA IN THE WHOLE UNIT - chleba - and it is here for exactly the reason this node's spine note flagged: the unit states 'masculine takes -u' (telefon -> telefonu, pokoj -> pokoju, dom -> domu), and chleb is the one high-frequency masculine in this course that refuses it. chleb has been owned since leaf_food_a1, it sits inside poprosze chleb, and b2_jesli's own type stage has kupie chleb, so teaching the rule while leaving chleba out would set Dad up to build chlebu on a word he uses constantly. Handed over as ONE boxed exception (the dziecmi / ludzmi / kelnerzy closed-set idiom), never as a sub-rule, and the non-word chlebu is never printed anywhere, distractors included. EVERYTHING ELSE IS RECYCLED - both halves of every pair are owned, which is why a rule this broad costs almost nothing. THE MATCH BOARD IS SIX MINIMAL PAIRS, positive row then negative row, because the contrast IS the content. THE MASCULINE-ANIMATE PAIR IS THE RELIEF: Mam psa -> Nie mam psa, nothing changes at all, since AGENTS.md's named Acc=Gen exception means the object form of a man or an animal already IS the genitive. SLIDE 3 IS A GUARD AGAINST OVER-APPLICATION and is deliberate rather than a second fact: only a direct OBJECT moves, so Nie mieszkam w domu, Nie jestem lekarzem, Nie ide do sklepu and Nie pomagam mamie are all unchanged - quiz items 11 and 12 are that guard, in the idiom of b2_num_virile's osoba guard. HOMOGRAPH CHECKS: gazety stays out of every object slot (a2_plural_nom owns that string as a NOMINATIVE PLURAL); wina is not used as a genitive of wino for the same reason; drogi appears nowhere (leaf_shopping_a1 owns it as the adjective 'expensive'); piwa and ksiazki are used only in the genitive-singular job their own packs taught them in. FENCED AND LOGGED: PLURAL OBJECTS (Nie mam gazet) are legal by now and are still held - the unit has one fact and number is orthogonal to it; b2_case_gym and b2_wrapup are where that recombination belongs, and this is the one scope call James might want to overturn. Also fenced: samochodu, adresu, cukru, soku, biletu, klucza, kurtke (all verified NEW); chlebu, never printed; no oblique pronouns; no plural oblique adjectives (O3 -> C1), the seventh bare-noun unit running.

nodes.label: Nikt nie pracuje · nigdzie nie idę
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 2 (spine O13 - an addition beyond the routine brief's list, logged in the spine rather than guessed silently). Obligatory double negation: a negative word AND a second nie on the verb, both, always. TWO NEW LEMMAS ONLY - nikt and nigdzie - because nic (a2_smalltalk, frozen inside nic nowego) and nigdy (leaf_time_cal_a1) are already owned, so the learner arrives holding half the set and none of the syntax. ZADEN IS DROPPED, a deliberate departure from the spine's own list and the one scope call here: it is an adjective-shaped word with a full declension whose natural home (Nie mam zadnej ksiazki) stacks a new declining word directly on top of b2_neg_gen one node earlier; zaden/zadna/zadne are fenced entirely, verified NEW, C1 inbox. THE UNIT IS NOT TITLED 'Nikt nie wie' despite that being the spine's headline phrase: check_new.py reports wie NEW, since wiem is owned only inside the frozen chunk nie wiem, so wie would be a new form of an irregular verb whose paradigm nobody owns - it appears nowhere, title included. SLIDE 3 IS A CONSOLIDATION, NOT A SECOND FACT: because the verb still carries nie, the object stays in the of-form (Nigdy nie pije kawy, Nikt nie kupuje chleba), so the unit re-drills b2_neg_gen at zero cost and the two nodes are adjacent for that reason. WORD ORDER IS NEGATIVE-WORD-FIRST THROUGHOUT; Nie ma nikogo and every other order is held. HOMOGRAPH CHECKS: nic is re-taught explicitly in its own slot (the dziekuje / ktorej / ze treatment) because a2_smalltalk owns it only inside nic nowego; gazety appears in no object slot, since a2_plural_nom owns that string as a NOMINATIVE PLURAL; czasami is deliberately not a distractor for czasu, because it means 'sometimes'. FENCED, all verified NEW: nikogo, nikomu, niczego; wie, wiesz, rozumiem, ktos, gdzies, wszedzie, wszyscy; and the past with nikt as subject, which takes masculine-singular agreement and is a second fact. No oblique pronouns (a fence audit.py cannot see, GLUE_LEMMAS); no plural oblique adjectives (O3 -> C1), the eighth bare-noun unit running. Pisanie honours the James-locked 3-word cap: four typed-whole items, six cloze with the blank on the teaching point.

nodes.label: Jak się mówi? · Tu się nie pali
nodes.label_en: Impersonal się — sentences with nobody in them
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 3. Impersonal sie: a construction with NO SUBJECT AT ALL, verb parked in the 3sg - Jak sie mowi po polsku?, Gdzie sie kupuje bilet?, Tu sie nie pali, Mowi sie, ze sklep jest zamkniety. Extends a2_sie's framing (sie BELONGS to the verb, never 'self') to the case where nobody is doing anything in particular. ONE NEW VERB IN THE UNIT - palic/pali; every other verb on screen is an owned 3sg (mowi, robi, kupuje, pracuje, pije, czeka), which is why a construction this useful is cheap. SIE IS RE-TAUGHT IN A NEW JOB explicitly on slide 1 (the dziekuje / ktorej / ze / nic treatment). WORD ORDER IS A TABLE FACT, NEVER A RULE (a2_jechac ja-/je- precedent): a2_sie fenced clitic placement by name and B2-SPINE hands sie-placement beyond 'after the verb' to C1 (inbox 19), so the pack shows exactly TWO shapes - front word + sie + verb (literally the taught Jak sie masz? order), or verb + sie (Mowi sie, ze...) - and says out loud there is nothing to work out. It never claims sie goes 'second in the clause'. HOMOGRAPH TRAP IN THE UNIT'S OWN NEW WORD: bare 'Pali sie.' means THERE IS A FIRE, so the pack never prints pali sie unfronted - every occurrence is Tu sie nie pali / W szpitalu sie nie pali - and slide 4 warns the learner to keep the phrase whole. FENCED, all verified NEW: pisze, placi, sprzedaje, otwiera (the four verbs that would have written the most natural sign sentences, all NEW 3sg of paradigms nobody owns); je (NEW + collides with the pronoun je), so 'Co sie tu je?' is not offered; wie, CAUGHT IN THIS PACK'S OWN DRAFT and rewritten - the third consecutive pack to trip on that string; the past impersonal (mowilo sie) and the -no/-to forms; duzo hung on a verb; plural objects; objects under negation; siebie/sobie (O15 -> C1); all oblique pronouns (a fence audit.py cannot see - GLUE_LEMMAS). Pisanie: all ten items cloze, since every sentence this construction makes is composed by definition; blanks on the 3sg verb, on sie itself in item 7, and one logged non-teaching-point blank in item 8 to avoid a duplicate answer.

nodes.label: Proszę o kawę
nodes.label_en: Asking for things · prosić o + Accusative
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 4. PAYS B1-DIGEST DEFERRED ITEM 3 (spine O11). prosic o + ACCUSATIVE. b1_giving deferred it and asked James whether it needed a slot; b1_polite separately dropped 'Poprosze o...' for the same reason - o is already taught as a LOCATIVE governor (a2_o_loc, mowie o pracy), so o + Accusative is a live homograph trap ON A FUNCTION WORD. THREE NEW FORMS: prosic, prosisz, prosi - the -e/-isz class already owned from mowic/robic/lubic, so the endings cost nothing, and the s->sz of prosze is a TABLE FACT, never a rule. PROSZE IS THE REAL TRAP AND THE BEST SLIDE: one string, three jobs the learner has now met - please/here you are (A1), Prosze + dictionary verb = polite instruction (a2_imperative), and from here the 1sg of prosic. Slide 3 sets all three side by side and names what tells them apart: a verb after it = instruction, an o after it = asking. Poprosze rachunek (taught) and Poprosze o rachunek are BOTH stated correct rather than one replacing the other; with the verb prosic the o is obligatory, and that is the unit's one hard fact. THE CONTRAST IS CROSS-NOUN, NOT A MINIMAL PAIR, flagged in the pack as its own weakness: kawie, wodzie, prace and szkole are ALL verified NEW, so no noun in the course owns both its Locative and its Accusative - two columns carry it instead (mowic/myslec + in-form vs prosic + object form) with o constant. FENCED, all verified NEW: pomoc, dropped deliberately though Prosze o pomoc is the most useful sentence here, because pomoc is a soft feminine whose Accusative equals its Nominative and would show a pattern in which nothing visibly moves (logged as the obvious top-up if James wants the unit bigger); klucza (caught in a draft use item, already fenced by name in b2_neg_gen), prace, szkole, kawie, wodzie, herbacie, rachunku, kawiarni; the plural persons; prosic with a person as well as a thing; the past of prosic and perfective poprosic as a verb; siebie/sobie; all oblique pronouns (GLUE_LEMMAS blind spot). Match carries the bare infinitive as its own row so all four forms appear without dropping the three o + Locative contrast rows. Pisanie: two typed whole (both three-word minimal pattern units), one bare dictionary form, seven cloze on the teaching point.

nodes.label: Idę, chodzę, jadę, jeżdżę
nodes.label_en: The motion grid closed · going by vehicle, regularly
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 5. Closes the motion grid a2_chodzic left open - that pack fenced jezdzic so hard its own note says the word is 'not named, glossed, hinted at or used as a distractor anywhere in this file, note included', which is why its slide 3 borrowed jechac only for its ENDINGS. SEVEN NEW STRINGS, ONE VERB: jezdzic, jezdze, jezdzisz, jezdzi, jezdzimy, jezdzicie, jezdza. Nothing else in the pack is new - the other three corners (isc/chodzic from a2_chodzic, jechac from a2_jechac) are owned in full, so three quarters of what is on screen is recall. THE GRID IS THE PAYOFF, NOT THE PARADIGM: two independent questions decide the verb (on foot or by vehicle; now or regularly), four Polish verbs where English has one word, and English gives nothing to hang the split on. The owned adverbs teraz/codziennie/czesto/zawsze do the semantic work in every item. LOAD IS ONE NEW SYSTEM AND BARELY THAT: the -e/-isz class is owned from chodzic, and the z/zdz split (jezdze, jezdza at the outside vs the middle four) is a TABLE FACT only - explicitly the same shape as jade/jedziesz, which a2_jechac already handed over the same way. Match board: all six new forms plus six anchor rows building the four-way grid at ja and ty, so every new form is on the board and the board IS the contrast; the infinitive rides the intro plus a Pisanie item (a2_chodzic precedent). FENCED, all verified NEW: przyjezdzam/wyjezdzam and the whole prefixed imperfective family, which belongs to b2_motion_imperf in the JAMES-LOCKED Block 6a - teaching them here would open the secondary-imperfective strand four nodes early; jezdzilem and ALL past forms of both by-vehicle verbs (a2_chodzic's fence kept unchanged); the future and the imperatives; do Polski, do kina, do lekarza, each of which killed a natural destination sentence, so only owned do-phrases appear; siebie/sobie; all oblique pronouns (GLUE_LEMMAS blind spot). TAUGHT-AS: the transport instrumentals are used in exactly a2_inst_transport's bare-means job, never after z; gory is deliberately absent, since a2_travel owns that string as a plural noun. Pisanie is ten single forms typed whole - the minimal pattern unit for a conjugation, nothing composed anywhere near the cap.

nodes.label: Poszedłem, wszedłem, doszedłem
nodes.label_en: Went, went in, got as far as
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 6 (spine O7.1). Pays the catch b1_wrapup's digest recorded: poszedlem was rejected mid-draft as 'a THIRD prefix on isc's suppletive past stem' that was never taught. FIVE VERBS: pojsc/wejsc/dojsc on the suppletive szedl table (whole, mirror-table, the b1_past_isc treatment) plus pojechac/dojechac on the regular -ac past rule owned since a2_past_ac. 55 new forms, ALL verified NEW by check_new.py with zero collisions. ONE GOVERNOR THROUGHOUT, do + genitive, owned since A1 - so the three on-foot verbs contrast on a single frame: poszedlem do sklepu (made the trip) / wszedlem do sklepu (through the door) / doszedlem do sklepu (reached it on foot). SCOPE CUT vs the spine's four prefixes, logged in the pack note and the digest: prze- dropped entirely (przejsc needs przez + Accusative, an untaught governor - a second new system in one unit) and wjechac dropped (we-/w- shape split between the stems, a third irregularity with no everyday payoff). NO PREFIX MEANING CLAIMED ANYWHERE, per the JAMES-LOCKED O7 overrule: po-/we- are outside the core-4 lens set and do- belongs to b2_prefix_lens two units later, so the unit says each verb is learned as a word and the front piece is not a rule the learner may apply. pojsc's relation to szedlem is given the b1_arrive_leave treatment ('once and done, like kupilem') as a fact about that verb, never generalised - that is b2_prefix_two_jobs' content. THE AWKWARD CORNER IS NAMED, NOT HIDDEN: wejsc keeps its e in the feminine (weszlam) and loses it in the masculine (wszedlem); handed over whole and drilled in four type items. Singular only, both genders in production; futures in the three singular persons. FENCED: wychodzic/przychodzic and every imperfective partner (b2_motion_imperf, one node away); prze-, za-, od-; przez; wjechac; plural past; oni/one; conditional; bedzie and the two-futures contrast. Pisanie is 19 single forms typed whole - the minimal pattern unit for a conjugation, nothing composed anywhere near the cap.

nodes.label: Pisać czy napisać?
nodes.label_en: Four more pairs · doing it, and getting it done
nodes.note: B2 Block 6, unit 7 (spine O7.2). A closed set of new aspect pairs learned WHOLE, no rule - and the pack restates a2_aspect's 'the prefixes are unpredictable, learn the pair whole' framing out loud, as the spine required. THE SPINE'S PREMISE WAS WRONG AND THIS UNIT CORRECTS IT: B2-SPINE says 'every imperfective member is already owned, so each pair is one new word, not two'; check_new.py says sprzatac AND posprzatac are BOTH new, pisac is owned as an infinitive only, and gotowac/jesc/placic are owned in the present but never in the past. CONSEQUENCES, both logged: sprzatac/posprzatac DROPPED (the only pair costing two verbs, which is the arithmetic the spine used to justify the set), and the IMPERFECTIVE PAST of the four survivors is taught here rather than assumed - three of four are free applications of the owned past rule, only jadlem/jadlam costs a whole form. Plus one extra form, pisze, so napisze sits on an anchored stem and b2_pisac_family finds the root usable as Block 6a assumes. 41 new forms, all verified NEW, zero collisions. PAYS A NAMED IOU: a2_shopping_func dropped 'Czy moge zaplacic karta?' because zaplacic is perfective; it is taught here. NO PREFIX MEANING CLAIMED - na-/u-/z-/za- are named as unpredictable, never as meanings, leaving b2_prefix_lens and b2_prefix_two_jobs their material. Dopasuj is a balanced 4x3 board: each pair contributes its imperfective past, perfective past and perfective future in the ja form, so the board IS the contrast. FENCED: sprzatac/posprzatac; the imperfective future (bede pisac) - b1_two_futures owns that contrast; 3sg/2sg imperfective pasts; all plural; oni/one; conditional; imperatives. Pisanie is 18 single forms typed whole.

nodes.label: Powinienem · musiałem
nodes.label_en: Should — and the past of must
nodes.note: [B2 Block 6 unit 8] Modal completion. Pays two a2_musiec fences: the past of musiec and the gender it removed. ONE THEME, TWO PLACES - powinienem/powinnam is a PRESENT form that carries gender (the only helper that does), musialem/musiala is the ordinary past; trzeba bylo / mozna bylo pick up nothing at all, which is the contrast. 14 new forms, ZERO new endings: powinien takes the past-tense person markers -em/-s/zero owned since a2_past_byc, and musiec's past is past_ac's shape. The e->a shift (musia-, like chcia-) is NOT explained - forms handed over whole on the chcialem precedent, rule booked for C1. SINGULAR ONLY. FENCED, all verified NEW: plural (powinnismy, musieli), neuter (powinno), conditional powinienem byl (O6), and the PAST OF MOC (moglem) under b1_polite's unresolved MOGLBY QUARANTINE - moc is NEW even as an infinitive, so the third modal has no past in this course and the pack says so. Negation fenced, inheriting a2_musiec's open fork. Perfective complements now allowed (aspect_prefixes taught the twins). TITLE: both Polish words are taught by this pack. See B2-SPINE Block 6.

nodes.label: Czytanie, pisanie, gotowanie
nodes.note: [B2 Block 7 unit 1] The verbal noun, -anie/-enie. THE BEST-ANCHORED UNIT IN B2: check_new.py finds NINETEEN of these already taught as ordinary nouns between path 3 and 143 (pisanie, czytanie, plywanie, bieganie, spotkanie, mieszkanie, jedzenie, zdanie, danie, zadanie, badanie, znaczenie, cwiczenie, szkolenie, zaproszenie, ubezpieczenie, wynagrodzenie, opoznienie, leczenie), so the unit teaches SIX new words and re-reads a pile he has owned for a hundred nodes. SPINE LIST CORRECTED: sprzatanie DROPPED - sprzatac itself is verified NEW, so both halves would have been new; czekanie, granie, kupowanie replace it. THE -AC RULE IS GIVEN PRODUCTIVELY (drop c, add -nie - mechanical); THE -ENIE GROUP IS NOT - robienie and mowienie handed over as words, with the owned znaczenie/leczenie/zaproszenie shown as proof the stem changes unpredictably. NEUTER THROUGHOUT is the second gift and it is free: adjective -e, past bylo, and Accusative = Nominative, so the noun does not move when it becomes an object. Hardened meanings named rather than left as a trap (mieszkanie = a flat). FENCED, and the first is a real scope cut: GENITIVE OBJECTS after a verbal noun (gotowanie obiadu) appear nowhere - a second system; every verbal noun here stands bare. Also fenced: all oblique forms of the six new nouns, perfective verbal nouns, reflexive ones, the plural. No fabricated non-words in any distractor. See B2-SPINE Block 7.

nodes.label: Otwarty, zamknięty, zrobiony
nodes.note: [B2 Block 7 unit 2, spine O4] The passive adjectival participle - PREDICATE POSITION and PRESENT TENSE only, the only participle in B2. ANCHOR CONFIRMED: otwarty and zamkniety are already taught by leaf_shopping_a1 at path 20 as plain adjectives, and otworzyc is owned - so the opening claim is that two shop-door words are built from verbs. SAME SHAPE AS b2_verbal_nouns ONE NODE EARLIER, which is why it is cheap: rule for the -ac class (stem + -ny), whole words for the -ic class (-ony with an unpredictable stem change: zrobiony b->bi, zaplacony c->c). nodes.label: Pociąg jest opóźniony
nodes.note: [B2 Block 8 unit 1, spine O12] SITUATIONS unit, chunk lane, genre of a2_directions_func / b1_polite; reuses the existing situation_chunk structure ID as every *_func pack does - no new ID. English calls both 'late'; Polish does not - a PERSON is spozniony, a SERVICE is opozniony. Slide 2 is that split. ODLOT/PRZYLOT are transparent: lot is taught and odjazd/przyjazd are the taught LAND pair, so od-+lot and przy-+lot read off parts already owned; the b2_prefix_lens link is drawn in ONE receptive line per the James-locked O7 overrule and invites no derivation. CASE LEAKS KILLED BY check_new.py: pociagu, autobusu, peronie, lotnisku, bagazu, biletu, noclegu are ALL NEW, so 'do pociagu' / 'na peronie' / 'na lotnisku' are impossible and absent - hence wsiadac/wysiadac taught in the prosze + infinitive frame only. dworcu and hotelu ARE taught and are used. Agreement is thin because pociag/autobus/lot are all masculine; only wazny takes a second form (wazna). nodes.label: Uważam, że…

THE SPINE'S LIST WAS CUT BY ONE and it is the loudest call in the batch: the spine offers 'wydaje mi sie', but check_new.py reports WYDAJE AS ALREADY TAUGHT by b2_verb_family2 at path 170 - FIVE NODES BACK - where it is the 3sg of wydawac, TO SPEND MONEY. mi and sie are owned too, so the whole phrase would be assembled from three owned strings all meaning something else, at the worst possible distance. Verified by script that every occurrence of racje/zgadzam/zgadzasz/pewno in learner-facing text sits inside its whole chunk. WEDLUG in one frozen phrase only (taty, lekarza both NEW, so wedlug taty is unbuildable); wedlug mnie works because mnie is genuinely syncretic, named in one line. UWAZAM IS FIRST PERSON ONLY on the wiem-quarantine pattern; the consequence is stated and the learner asks back with owned material (Dlaczego tak myslisz?). NIE MIEC RACJI FENCED per B2-SPINE leaves-to-C1 item 12. Synonym pairs (uwazam/mysle, wedlug mnie/moim zdaniem) forced every quiz choice list to exclude a true rival of its own answer. nodes.label: Wychodzę · przychodzę
nodes.note: B2 Block 6a unit 1 (JAMES-LOCKED, spine O7 overrule). Secondary-imperfective bridge: wychodzic/przychodzic/wyjezdzac/przyjezdzac as the everyday partners of the owned wyjsc/przyjsc/wyjechac/przyjechac. nodes.label: Wyjść czy przyjść?
nodes.label_en: Reading the front of the verb · out, to, up-to, back
nodes.note: B2 Block 6a unit 2 (JAMES-LOCKED). RECEPTIVE-ONLY lens on the core 4: wy- out, przy- to/arrive, do- all-the-way, od- away/back. ZERO new lemmas - every example is already-taught material re-seen. Receptive-only is STRUCTURAL: type_items and use_items are empty arrays, on the live b1_virile_reco 'recognition only' precedent, so the learner never types a prefixed verb at all. nodes.label: Wypić czy wyjść?
nodes.label_en: The same prefix, two different jobs
nodes.note: B2 Block 6a unit 3 (JAMES-LOCKED decision #3). The two jobs a prefix does: JOB 1 leaves the verb's meaning alone and only puts an end on it (pic/wypic, robic/zrobic, czytac/przeczytac, pisac/napisac) and flips the tense (zrobie = I will make); JOB 2 makes a different verb with its own meaning (isc -> przyjsc/wyjsc/dojsc, dawac -> oddawac). ZERO NEW MATERIAL - teaches_lemmas is empty; the unit teaches a discrimination and declares the structure prefix_two_jobs alone, on the b2_prefix_lens precedent. Landing line carried by the wypic/wyjsc minimal pair (the title): the same wy- does both jobs, so you learn which job from the PAIR, not the front piece - the handoff b2_prefix_lens set up when it excluded wypic from its lens. b1_two_futures idiom, so the ladder is full (match/quiz/Pisanie/Uzycie), but production is always CHOOSING between owned forms, never building a prefixed verb; Pisanie is 12 single-word forms so the 3-word cap is met by construction. No meta-questions in Kontrola - the spine's 'which job is the prefix doing?' would be a question ABOUT the language, so every quiz item is a real form in a real sentence. TITLE CORRECTED from the planned 'Przedrostki - dwie prace': both przedrostki and prace are untaught Polish, which the AGENTS title rule forbids in learner-visible chrome. FENCED: pojsc/pojechac (po- on isc is aspectual, a third fact - logged for C1); any formation rule; za-/po-/prze- as readable prefixes. REGISTER: authored to James's 2026-08-06 learner-model ruling - the intro names the real categories (prefix, aspect, perfective, imperfective, derivation), not the 'front piece / twins' framing the earlier prefix units use; b2_prefix_lens and b2_motion_imperf still need the intro-register sweep to match. See B2-SPINE Block 6a.

nodes.label: Podpisać czy zapisać?

Root usable only because b2_aspect_prefixes taught pisze for exactly this unit, as its own note predicted. nodes.label: Daję, oddaję, wydaję, podaję

Seven new forms, one new verb (podawac), ZERO new endings - all four run on dawac's present_e_esz paradigm. THE LENS REACHES TWO OF FOUR: od- in oddawac is the lens's own od-, wy- in wydawac is NOT spatial (pays b2_prefix_lens's named exclusion of this verb), pod- in podawac is the same pod- as podpisac one node back doing something else. IMPERFECTIVE/PRESENT/SINGULAR ONLY - dac, oddac, wydac, podac all NEW and fenced (dac is the irregular dam/dasz/da). No aspect twin here, unlike b2_pisac_family: all four are already imperfective. nodes.label: Jest kawa · nie ma kawy
nodes.label_en: There is, there was, there will be
nodes.note: C1 Block 1, unit 1 — the level opens on its cheapest high-value unit, the b2_copular_future slot one level on. Zero new lemmas: jest/są, był/była/było/były, będzie/będą and nie ma are all owned, and so is every Genitive used. Pays two explicit fences at once — b2_copular_future's plain existential future (Będzie kawa, fenced as 'the twin of the negative') and the negated future nie będzie kawy, which b2_neg_gen never reached because it taught the Genitive of negation off a transitive verb only. The one fact is an asymmetry: the positive existential has a Nominative subject and być agrees with it in all four past shapes; the negative has no subject at all, so it is one frozen form per tense (nie ma / nie było / nie będzie) with the thing behind it in the Genitive. Going negative freezes the verb and moves the noun at the same time. Homograph catch that changed the unit: książki is taught only as a genitive singular (a1_gen_ki, a1_negation) and is not owned as a nominative plural, so 'there were books' appears nowhere; gazety carries every plural instead, in exactly the job a2_plural_nom taught it in. Fenced: plural adjectives, counted subjects, na + Accusative.

nodes.label: Znam czy wiem?
nodes.label_en: Two Polish verbs for one English 'know'
nodes.note: C1 Block 1, unit 2 — lifts the WIEM QUARANTINE (C1-SPINE O10), standing since a2_directions_func and re-held by b2_ze_clauses, b2_indirect_q and b2_double_neg. Six new forms, zero new endings: wiesz, wie, wiemy, wiecie, wiedzą and the infinitive wiedzieć; wiem owned since a2_directions_func. The endings are the -m/-sz set owned since A1 on mieć, run as a parallel down the page, with wiedzą named as the one place the parallel breaks. The wiedzieć/znać split costs one paradigm and not two — znać/znam are taught since a1_present [15] — and the test given is syntactic rather than semantic: a clause takes wiedzieć, a person or thing takes znać. Unblocks Czy wiesz, gdzie jest apteka? — the sentence b2_indirect_q's digest named as the one Dad most needs and cannot say. Accusative objects are pool-limited and shaped the unit (tę, kobietę, kolegę, lekarza all verified NEW), so every znać object is a masculine inanimate, a neuter, or the honest Acc≡Gen animate. Fenced: wiedza the noun, the past wiedziałem, umieć, and je (3sg of jeść, held for c1_pron_je).

nodes.label: Dużo dobrych filmów
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 1 (C1-SPINE O2) — the first unit of the largest untaught system left in the course. B2-SPINE O3 sent the plural adjective to C1 and nine consecutive B2 units shipped bare-noun because of it. The Genitive comes first because it is the one oblique case where the learner already puts plurals: dużo + Genitive plural since a1_gen_endings, nie ma + Genitive plural since a2_gen_pl, noun families closed by b2_gen_pl_full. Four new forms, one ending — the singular made the learner choose between -ego and -ej, the plural has nothing to choose: -ych covers masculine, feminine and neuter alike. dobrych, nowych, małych, dużych all verified NEW; stary and zimny were dropped because stare and zimne are themselves NEW as nominative plurals and could not anchor the Nominative→Genitive table. Zero new governors, and nie było / nie będzie come from c1_existential two nodes back. Distractor catch: dużego is verified NEW (b2_adj_gen dropped duży), so three drafted distractors were replaced. Fenced absolutely: -ym, -ymi and every virile form.

nodes.label: W dużych sklepach
nodes.label_en: Plural adjectives in the Locative · -ych again
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 2 (C1-SPINE O2) — -ych doing its second job, and the course's 'same ending, another job' idiom on its fifth turn (inst_identity -> inst_z -> inst_transport -> b2_adj_inst -> here). ZERO NEW FORMS in the whole unit, so teaches_lemmas is legitimately empty on the copular_future / adj_inst / ze_clauses / passive / existential_tense convention: dobrych, nowych, małych and dużych came from c1_adj_pl_gen one node back, every noun is one of the eleven Locative plurals b2_loc_pl owns, and all three governors (w, na, o) have been in the course since A1/A2. Unblocks the sentence b2_loc_pl's digest flagged as unsayable — w dużych miastach, 'in the big cities'. The spine's own illustration Myślę o starych filmach is unbuildable and was replaced rather than smuggled in: starych and filmach are BOTH verified NEW. na appears exactly once because biurkach is the only one of the eleven nouns that takes it. The singular contrast is fully owned (b2_adj_loc's -ym, b2_adj_gen's -ej), so the choice is shown honestly and then collapsed across all three genders. Distractor catch, recurring from the previous node: duży has no taught singular oblique — dużym, dużego, dużej are all NEW — so every singular row uses dobry/nowy/mały. Fenced: no -ymi (c1_adj_pl_inst) and no plural-Dative -ym (c1_adj_pl_dat); -ym appears only as the singular Locative b2_adj_loc taught, and c1_adj_pl_dat must name that collision rather than assume it. No virile forms; ludzie appears once as a bare subject with no adjective on it. Pisanie is eight three-word prepositional phrases — the Locative has no minimal unit without its governor, which is the w domu shape AGENTS names.

nodes.label: Z dobrymi kolegami
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 3 (C1-SPINE O2) — the Instrumental plural, -ymi, and the block's only genuinely new ending after the Genitive. Three new forms: dobrymi, nowymi, małymi. The unit's one discrimination is that THE PLURAL UNDOES A MERGER THE SINGULAR HAD: b2_adj_inst's headline was that masculine and neuter share one form across Locative and Instrumental (w dobrym hotelu / z dobrym kolegą), and in the plural they come apart — -ych after w/na/o, -ymi after z. A genuine design fork, taken and logged: this unit uses person nouns with adjectives and its two siblings did not. b2_inst_pl taught twelve Instrumental plurals and eleven are people; the only non-person is kotami and every alternative is NEW, so the sibling fence would have produced a twelve-row board about cats. It is safe because the Instrumental plural has NO virile split — -ymi is uniform, no virile form appears, and no person noun takes an adjective in the Nominative. duży is dropped for lack of any natural collocation with people, so the unit teaches three adjectives and duży keeps dużych but gains no Instrumental plural — a gap c1_adj_pl_dat and c1_adj_pl_gym inherit, logged rather than papered over. Two of the three Instrumental jobs have plurals here (z + people, and identity after być); bare transport has none. Fenced: no plural-Dative -ym (next node); -ym and -ą appear only as the singular forms b2_adj_inst owns.

nodes.label: Nowym studentom
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 4 (C1-SPINE O2) — the Dative plural, -ym, and the block's sharpest homograph. Zero new forms: dobrym, nowym and małym have been taught since b2_adj_loc and were re-used by b2_adj_inst, so teaches_lemmas is legitimately empty for the second time in this block. THE TRAP IS THE UNIT, and the spine named it in advance: -ym is also the singular m/n Locative and Instrumental ending, so this is the same string in a THIRD job — and unlike the block's earlier re-sightings, which changed case while holding number, this one changes NUMBER. w dobrym hotelu and z dobrym kolegą are singular; dobrym studentom is plural. The resolution given is the honest one: the noun settles it, because -om is the Dative plural and nothing else in the course ends that way. The person-noun fork carries forward from c1_adj_pl_inst for the identical lexical reason — b2_dat_pl taught twelve Dative plurals and eleven are people — and is safe on the same ground: the Dative plural has no virile split. duży is absent again, and this time not by choice: b2_adj_dat taught only dobremu/nowemu/małemu and duży has no singular oblique anywhere, so the gap logged at c1_adj_pl_inst is now block-wide and c1_adj_pl_gym inherits it. The singular-to-plural table has two rows because only studentowi/studentom and siostrze/siostrom have both numbers taught; the neuter row carries an em dash rather than a fabricated form. Slide 4 is the block's summary board — four oblique cases, three strings — and says plainly that the Nominative and Accusative plural adjective is taught nowhere yet. Use item 7 pays the spine's logged inbox item (a Dative plural noun in the podoba się frame) as one use item, not a strand.

nodes.label: Dobrzy czy dobre?
nodes.label_en: Plural adjectives for a group with a man in it
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 5 (C1-SPINE O2) — the virile plural adjective, the men-group form, and the last teaching unit of the block. Four new forms, one idea: nowi, młodzi, zmęczeni (the virile Nominative plural) and zmęczone (the non-virile plural of the same adjective, so the split has both sides on one word). dobrzy is recycled, not taught — b1_virile_reco handed it over as a whole ready-made form with no rule at all, so this unit is the anchor shape: a form the learner has read since B1 turns out to be built by a pattern. The pattern is stated as a pattern over four owned words and never as a productive test: r→rz, w→wi, d→dz, n→ni. What makes it ONE new thing rather than four is that the learner already makes this move on the nouns — b1_virile_nom's 'look at the last consonant of the stem' — so the adjective in front is one familiar operation reaching a second word class. THE SPINE'S OWN mali AND duzi ARE DROPPED and that is the unit's one real fork: no virile noun this course owns collocates with a size adjective, every taught virile noun being an adult occupational or relational noun, and the natural home for mali is chłopcy or synowie, both verified NEW. nowi is substituted — ordinary Polish with every person noun, and the only adjective besides dobry whose masculine, feminine and non-virile plural are all taught. Pays b2_copular_future's absolute fence on plural predicate adjectives (Jesteśmy zmęczeni / Jesteśmy zmęczone), which b1_virile_gym and b1_conditional_pl each record nearly shipping by mistake. The Accusative is the second consequence and runs on owned strings only — virile Accusative plural = Genitive plural on noun and adjective alike, with the borrowing named on the slide and anchored on Znam brata. The women-only row is the sharpest discrimination: Córki są zmęczone says the category is masculine-personal, not human. Title corrected at the wire from the planned 'Mali, duzi, zmęczeni', two of whose three forms this unit no longer teaches.

nodes.label: Siłownia · dobrych, dobrymi, dobrym
nodes.note: C1 Block 2, unit 6 — the plural adjective gym, and the close of the block (C1-SPINE O11). Gym idiom: ZERO new material, teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both empty. It earns its path slot under AGENTS' gyms rule because three strings (-ych, -ymi, -ym) are spread across six jobs and -ych alone does three of them — Genitive, Locative, and the virile Accusative that landed one node ago — with nothing inside the adjective to say which. A same-string-many-jobs collision is what massed discrimination is for. This is the only new gym in C1 besides the c1_case_gym closer. Slide 3 is the one genuinely new thought and it reduces load rather than adding it: of the six jobs the men/not-men split shows in exactly two, the subject form and the object form, and in all four oblique jobs the plural adjective is one form for everyone. Each oblique unit could only say that about itself; this is the first node able to say it about the whole block. duży's paradigm hole is inherited rather than fixed — it has dużych and nothing else oblique anywhere in the course — so duży appears only in Genitive and Locative slots and quiz 9's distractors are built from duże/dużo/duża. No virile Locative anywhere, which is lexical: lekarzach and studentach are both verified NEW. All twelve quiz answers are distinct, which took work in a gym whose point is one string answering to three triggers; the collision is preserved by keeping the choice set identical across items 1, 3 and 10 while the answers differ. Item 12 carries forward the women-only guard from c1_adj_pl_virile.

nodes.label: Łatwy czy trudny?
nodes.note: C1 Block 2 vocab (C1-SPINE O8) — evaluative adjectives, and the pack that pays the oldest open IOU in the course. Twelve new words, every one re-verified NEW with check_new.py at this node's own path position: łatwy, trudny, gotowy, pusty, pełny, dziwny, zwykły, oczywisty, konieczny, możliwy, niemożliwy, skuteczny. a1_trunk_adjectives deferred łatwy/trudny at A1 for want of an anchorable noun; there are hundreds now. Twenty taught forms for twelve words, the b2_abstract shape — eight of them are the feminine, neuter or plural of a word whose masculine is taught here, built by agreement rules the learner has just spent five units drilling, and tagged so the auditor can police them. THE ANCHOR RULE DECIDED THE SENTENCE BANK: AGENTS names this pack's own trap in its text ("never write lookalike frames where both halves are new — To jest łatwe / trudne"), so neither headline word is ever introduced in a bare To jest frame; łatwy arrives on Angielski jest łatwy and trudny on Polski jest trudny. Four words take a lexical anchor already in the course rather than an icon — oczywisty from oczywiście, możliwy from możliwość and można, niemożliwy from możliwy, skuteczny from skutek — and the other eight carry an icon. THE HOMOGRAPH IS gotowy: gotować, gotowanie and ugotowany are all taught, gotowy looks like family and is not, and Obiad jest gotowy is about the dinner being finished rather than about anyone having cooked it. Named on the item. konieczny/koniec is the milder second case. Placed at the end of Block 2 on purpose and the placement is used: sentence 25 (W pustych sklepach nie ma chleba) runs the block's -ych on an adjective that did not exist until this pack, and pustych is the one plural oblique taught here.

nodes.label: Ludzie, których znam
nodes.label_en: Pointing back at more than one
nodes.note: C1 Block 3, unit 1 (C1-SPINE) - the plural relative, plus the Dative singular któremu. b2_ktory_full fenced every plural form of który and logged why: 'the relative declines like an adjective, so shipping plural relatives here would breach O3 by the back door'. Block 2 closed the plural adjective four nodes ago, so the debt is paid immediately. Four new strings - którzy, których, którymi, któremu - and two new JOBS on owned strings, deliberately not re-taught on the adj_pl_loc/adj_pl_dat convention: którym (singular Locative and Instrumental since b2_ktory_full) doing the Dative plural, and które (the neuter singular relative since b1_ktory_cases) doing the non-virile Nominative and Accusative plural. Both named out loud on their slides. The unit is ONE idea, not six forms: który takes the adjective's endings, and the learner produced every one of them during Block 2. których gets its own slide because it does three jobs, exactly as dobrych does - Genitive under negation, Locative after o/w, and the virile Accusative, the plural echo of Znam brata. The sharpest discrimination is NUMBER, not case, which is why któremu lands here: student, któremu pomagam against dzieci, którym pomagam. The resulting collision is named - którym now covers singular Locative, singular Instrumental and plural Dative - and the resolution is the antecedent, since the relative sits right beside the noun it points back at. Lexical limit logged: pomagać is the only Dative-governing verb whose form is owned, so it carries both Dative items in every stage. Homograph discipline on antecedents: książki and miasta are both taught ONLY as Genitive singulars and appear nowhere as plurals.

nodes.label: O mnie, o tobie, ze mną
nodes.label_en: Me and you, after a preposition
nodes.note: C1 Block 3, unit 2 (C1-SPINE) - the first and second person after a preposition, the half of the row b2_pron_prep deliberately did not build and named this unit as its own alternative. Also closes a2_o_loc's older fence ('the unit says about work / about home, never about you'). Six new strings - mną, tobie, ciebie, tobą, nami, wami - plus ze, which is a fact about the preposition rather than the pronoun. The one idea is an asymmetry: after o and do, ja, my and wy reuse the object forms mnie, nas, was, so three persons out of four cost nothing in two of the three cases; only ty is genuinely different, and it is different twice (tobie after o, ciebie after do). The Instrumental is where the new words are, four for four. Anchored on według mnie, which has been in the learner's mouth since B2 and was the only prepositional pronoun cell he owned. The ze rule is stated as a closed fact, not a productive one: Polish says ze mną and never z mną, he already says ze szkoły and ze sklepu, and mną is the ONLY pronoun it happens to. The short forms are fenced POSITIONALLY, not by emphasis - cię and ci sit beside the verb, ciebie and tobie follow a preposition - because the stressed use of the long forms belongs to c1_word_order. The Dative is not opened, on b2_pron_prep's own reason: no preposition in this course governs it. One extra governor taken and logged: od in its comparison job only (Brat jest starszy od ciebie), held to one slide row, one match item and one use item.

nodes.label: Znam je · czemu?
nodes.label_en: The forms for things, not people
nodes.note: C1 Block 3, unit 3 (C1-SPINE) - the object pronoun for things, and two homographs in one small unit, both flagged in advance by spine O13. Two new strings only: je and czemu. je pays b2_pron_acc's stated consequence ('after this unit them is expressible only for people') - that pack taught ich for a men-group and left everything else with no object pronoun at all. The first trap is why the VERB is in this unit: je is also the 3sg of jeść, and the spine named the risk - teach them together or the first Ona je reads as 'she them'. One cell, not a paradigm: jem and jesz are owned and zje is owned, so je is the single missing box; jemy, jecie and jedzą are deliberately not taught. The test given is positional because a positional test is one this learner can apply: if je is the only verb-shaped word in the clause it IS the verb; if a verb is already standing, je is its object. THE UNIT'S ONE REAL FORK is czemu, taken conservatively: it is taught as the everyday colloquial 'why' (a synonym of dlaczego), with one line naming it as the Dative of co - which the spine explicitly permits - because the Dative of a THING has no legal sentence in this course, the only Dative-governing verb owned being pomagać. prosić o + a pronoun is held permanently: the non-virile plural Accusative after a preposition is nie, which collides with the negator, the first Polish word this learner ever met.

nodes.label: Siebie · sobie

PLUS that pack's SECOND fence, the feminine Nominative hour (Jest trzecia / Jest godzina trzecia), which it called 'a THIRD inflected set' and deferred under the load-splitting rule. pietnascie, minut, kwadrans all verified TAUGHT; only the phrase shapes are new. HOMOGRAPH (spine O13): za is TAUGHT in its THANKING job only (b1_polite, dziekuje za) - name the second job, the b2_prosic_o treatment of o.

nodes.label: Piętnastego stycznia
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 8, unit 2. Inbox item 20's second half: full dates with month forms (pietnastego stycznia) - a2_ordinals_time's and a2_celebrations' shared fence. Month Genitives (stycznia, lutego, marca, maja...) all verified NEW. Rides the ordinals a2_ordinals_time already owns. FOURTH item on the spine O1 trim list (folds into c1_time_minutes).

nodes.label: Dwoje dzieci · dwaj studenci
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 8, unit 3. Inbox item 21: collective numerals dwoje, troje, piecioro (all verified NEW). PLUS dwaj, which b2_num_virile fenced with 'it is a second system - nominative numeral, nominative noun, plural verb - and would undo slide 2's entire claim in one line'. Both facts are about counting PEOPLE, which is why they share a unit and why it sits after the whole virile apparatus.

nodes.label: Wiele, wielu · pięć złotych
nodes.label_en: Quantity words, and the money noun
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 8, unit 4. wiele/wielu/kilka (all verified NEW) - logged as C1 items by b2_num_subject and b2_plural_gym. PLUS zloty/zlotych, the currency a2_shopping2 OMITTED because 'it declines adjectivally (piec zlotych) and a2_numbers_gen is not built, so teaching it would invite *piec zloty' - and Block 2 has since taught -ych, so the objection is gone. MONEY IS THE MOST EVERYDAY COUNTED NOUN THERE IS and it should not end the course untaught.

nodes.label: Chociaż, mimo że
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 9, unit 1. Inbox item 23, first half: chociaz, mimo ze (both verified NEW). ZERO NEW MORPHOLOGY - b2_conjunctions' idiom, invariable words joining clauses the learner can already build. ONE contrast taught with a table (concession vs the plain contrast ale already does), not derived.

nodes.label: Dlatego że, podczas gdy
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 9, unit 2. Inbox item 23, second half: dlatego ze, BARE dlatego, podczas gdy (all verified NEW), plus jezeli and gdy - the formal twins b2_jesli fenced. PAYS b2_conjunctions' LOGGED SCOPE CUT IN FULL: that pack dropped dlatego BECAUSE its everyday partner dlatego ze was on the C1 list, and refused to ship 'a half-taught pair pointing at a fenced construction'. Both halves land here together. ALSO carries the reversed jesli order (Bede w parku, jesli...) and the resumptive to, both held to C1 by b2_jesli.

nodes.label: Już nie, jeszcze nie
nodes.label_en: Not any more, not yet, not any
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 9, unit 3. Negative polarity and the last negative word. (a) juz nie / jeszcze nie: b2_conjunctions fenced BOTH senses absolutely, having taught juz/jeszcze in their positive jobs. (b) zaden/zadna/zadne, which b2_double_neg DROPPED from the spine's own list because 'zaden is adjective-shaped with a full declension and stacks a new declining word directly on top of neg_gen, taught one node earlier'. Block 2 and b2_neg_gen are both far behind now.

nodes.label: Bardziej, najbardziej
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 9, unit 4. Inbox item 11: bardziej / najbardziej + adjective (both verified NEW) - deferred by a1_comparatives AND by a2_superlatives, twice over, and named in both packs' own notes. THE DECISION RULE (which adjectives take the ending, which take bardziej) IS TAUGHT AS A TENDENCY WITH A CLOSED LIST OF THE ONES HE OWNS, never as a productive test - the b2_gen_pl_full fleeting-e precedent: this learner gets no value from a rule he cannot trust.

nodes.label: Cześć czy dzień dobry?
nodes.label_en: Formal and casual, side by side
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 9, unit 5 (spine O7, inbox item 22). SITUATIONS GENRE, near-zero new lemmas: the same errand said both ways with material already owned - Czesc / Dzien dobry, Chce / Chcialbym, Mozesz...? / Czy moglby pan...?, ty / pan. The one honest fact: Polish forces the choice earlier and more visibly than English does. The written/spoken split as a SYSTEM is refused (spine O12) - it is a lifetime's material, not a unit.

nodes.label: Siłownia · koniec
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 10, unit 1. ZERO NEW (spine O11). The final case board: everything b2_case_gym had, PLUS plural adjectives in five jobs, the closed pronoun system including 1st/2nd person after prepositions, and the irregular plurals. THIS BOARD WILL BE DENSER THAN b2_case_gym's, which already had to split across two intro slides - PLAN FOR THREE and log the call rather than compressing.

nodes.label: Wszystko, co znam
nodes.note: [C1 SPINE] Block 10, unit 2. THE COURSE CAPSTONE. Genre of a2_wrapup_func / b1_wrapup / b2_wrapup, ZERO NEW. Recombines the registers C1 added - evaluation, society, nuance, register-switching - into mixed scenes. FOUR REGISTERS, NO FIFTH, holding b1_wrapup's deliberate limit for the fourth time. TITLE: 'Koniec drogi' was rejected - drogi is TAUGHT as the ADJECTIVE 'expensive' (leaf_shopping_a1), b2_gen_pl_full's sharpest homograph catch. THE RUN THAT WIRES THIS LIVE writes codex/COURSE-COMPLETE.md, provided the repair queue is fully ticked.

nodes.label: Przedrostki · znaczenia
nodes.label_en: Prefixes · what they tend to mean
nodes.note: [C1, JAMES-LOCKED 2026-08-07 — LIFTS B1 Block 6a decision #1 for C1 only] Productive prefix semantics, extended lens: adds prze- (through/across/re-), pod- (under/approach), roz- (apart/spread) to the taught wy-/przy-/do-/od-. TAUGHT AS TENDENCIES, NEVER AS A RULE: every slide must say plainly that the tendency is strong but not guaranteed and that a new verb must be verified, not coined (the *wyrobic trap is the reason the ban existed). za-/po- KEEP their one-line "no promise" treatment - they are genuine grab-bags. Production is guarded: only verbs the course already owns. Sits AFTER both root families so every example is anchored in a known root. Homograph/reliability notes mandatory in the digest.

nodes.label: Wołacz · przypis
nodes.note: [C1, JAMES-LOCKED 2026-08-07] James: "mention it as a kind of footnote, for completion, but say that it is seldom used. do this at an appropriate point, e.g. when all the other cases have been covered." SMALL unit, placed after the final case gym so every other case is closed first. Names the Wolacz as the seventh case, states honestly that outside address chunks it is rare in everyday spoken Polish, and points BACK at the six address chunks b1_vocative_chunks already taught whole (Mamo/Tato/Babciu/Dziadku/Panie Piotrze/Pani Anno) as the forms that matter. NOT a paradigm: no endings table to produce from, no proper-name rule - B1 decision #4 is softened to a named footnote, NOT reopened as a case to learn. Recognition/awareness only.
